class IndependentTwoSlotStrategy(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_ready = False
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        if any(symbol not in data.Bars for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
        aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

        indicators_ready = (
            self.spy_sma.IsReady
            and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
            and self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma_ready
            and self.previous_aapl_close is not None
        )

        if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
            if aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        if indicators_ready:
            spy_crosses_above = (
                self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_close > self.spy_sma.Current.Value
            )
            spy_crosses_below = (
                self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_close < self.spy_sma.Current.Value
            )

            if self.Portfolio[self.spy].Quantity == 0:
                if spy_crosses_above:
                    self.SetHoldings(self.spy, 0.40)
            elif spy_crosses_below:
                self.Liquidate(self.spy)

            if self.Portfolio[self.aapl].Quantity == 0:
                if self.aapl_red_streak >= 3 and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                    quantity = int(20_000 // aapl_close)
                    if quantity > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
            elif self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
                self.Liquidate(self.aapl)

        self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
        self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        self.previous_spy_sma_ready = self.spy_sma.IsReady
        self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

            return

        # Slot 2: Strategy B

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)

        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.spy_buy_pending = False
        self.spy_sell_pending = False
        self.aapl_buy_pending = False
        self.aapl_sell_pending = False

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        for symbol in self.symbols:
            if symbol not in data.Bars:
                return

        aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close
        if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
            if aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
        self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

        if not self.spy_sma.IsReady or self.spy_sma.Samples < 101 or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            return

        spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
        spy_sma_today = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        spy_sma_yesterday = self.spy_sma.Previous.Value
        spy_close_yesterday = self.spy_sma.Previous.Input.Value

        spy_crosses_above = (
            spy_close_yesterday <= spy_sma_yesterday and
            spy_close > spy_sma_today
        )
        spy_crosses_below = (
            spy_close_yesterday >= spy_sma_yesterday and
            spy_close < spy_sma_today
        )

        # Slot 1: Strategy A
        spy_quantity = self.Portfolio[self.spy].Quantity
        if spy_quantity != 0 and spy_crosses_below and not self.spy_sell_pending:
            self.Liquidate(self.spy)
            self.spy_sell_pending = True
        elif spy_quantity == 0 and spy_crosses_above and not self.spy_buy_pending:
            self.SetHoldings(self.spy, 0.40)
            self.spy_buy_pending = True

        # Slot 2: Strategy B
        aapl_quantity = self.Portfolio[self.aapl].Quantity
        if (
            aapl_quantity != 0
            and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60
            and not self.aapl_sell_pending
        ):
            self.Liquidate(self.aapl)
            self.aapl_sell_pending = True
        elif (
            aapl_quantity == 0
            and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
            and not self.aapl_buy_pending
            and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000
        ):
            quantity = int(20_000 // aapl_close)
            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                self.aapl_buy_pending = True

    def OnOrderEvent(self, order_event: OrderEvent):
        if order_event.Status not in [OrderStatus.Filled, OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Invalid]:
            return

        if order_event.Symbol == self.spy:
            if order_event.Direction == OrderDirection.Buy:
                self.spy_buy_pending = False
            elif order_event.Direction == OrderDirection.Sell:
                self.spy_sell_pending = False

        elif order_event.Symbol == self.aapl:
            if order_event.Direction == OrderDirection.Buy:
                self.aapl_buy_pending = False
            elif order_event.Direction == OrderDirection.Sell:
                self.aapl_sell_pending = False

class TwoSlotStrategySystem(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.bars = {
            symbol: RollingWindow[TradeBar](101)
            for symbol in self.symbols
        }

        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(
            self.aapl,
            14,
            MovingAverageType.Wilders,
            Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0
        self.strategy_a_pending = False
        self.strategy_b_pending = False

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        for symbol in self.symbols:
            if data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol):
                self.bars[symbol].Add(data.Bars[symbol])

        if any(not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        if (
            self.bars[self.spy].Count < 101
            or self.bars[self.aapl].Count < 4
            or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
